title: 預力混凝土圍阻體與整體洩漏率試驗
titleEn: Prestressed Concrete Containment and Integrated Leak-Rate Testing
subcategoryTitle: 核安全、除役與後端土木工程
subcategoryTitleEn: Nuclear safety, decommissioning and back-end civil works
summary: 大型壓水式核電廠的圍阻體多為預力混凝土結構，內壁襯以鋼板，事故時必須承受數個大氣壓並維持氣密；課程以公開的設計原理與美國水晶河三號機 2009 年的圍阻體脫層事故為例，定量分析環向預力、鋼腱的摩擦損失、結構完整性試驗的變形、整體與局部洩漏率試驗，以及曲線鋼腱造成的徑向拉應力。
summaryEn: Containments of large pressurized-water plants are mostly prestressed concrete lined with steel plate, required to hold several atmospheres and stay leak-tight in an accident; using public design principles and the 2009 containment delamination at Crystal River 3 in the United States, the course quantifies hoop prestress, friction loss in tendons, deformation in the structural integrity test, integrated and local leak-rate tests, and radial tension caused by curved tendons.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.

nodes: 廢棄物或用過燃料來源

v30Focus: 圍阻體的結構與氣密驗證：預力、鋼腱摩擦損失、整體洩漏率試驗與脫層事故
v30FocusEn: Structural and leak-tight proof of a containment: prestress, tendon friction loss, the integrated leak-rate test and a delamination

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：預力混凝土圍阻體與整體洩漏率試驗
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Prestressed Concrete Containment and Integrated Leak-Rate Testing
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「圍阻體壓力與預力」與「圍阻體內的空氣質量與容許洩漏量」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Containment pressure and prestress" and "Air mass in a containment and the allowable leakage": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「圍阻體壓力與預力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Containment pressure and prestress" is correct?
options: 圍阻體是放射性物質與環境之間的最後一道實體屏障，必須承受管路斷裂事故時蒸汽釋放造成的內壓與溫度。
圍阻體的作用只是防止飛機撞擊。
圍阻體是完全不漏氣的。
optionsEn: The containment is the last physical barrier between radioactive material and the environment and must withstand the internal pressure and temperature of steam released by a pipe break.
The only purpose of a containment is to stop aircraft impact.
A containment does not leak at all.
quiz.explanation: 圍阻體是放射性物質與環境之間的最後一道實體屏障，必須承受管路斷裂事故時蒸汽釋放造成的內壓與溫度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The containment is the last physical barrier between radioactive material and the environment and must withstand the internal pressure and temperature of steam released by a pipe break. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 圍阻體壓力與預力：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Containment pressure and prestress: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「圍阻體壓力與預力」如何決定「預力混凝土圍阻體與整體洩漏率試驗」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Containment pressure and prestress” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Prestressed Concrete Containment and Integrated Leak-Rate Testing”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 圍阻體是放射性物質與環境之間的最後一道實體屏障，必須承受管路斷裂事故時蒸汽釋放造成的內壓與溫度。大型壓水式機組多採預力混凝土圓筒加半球或淺穹頂，內襯鋼板確保氣密；圓筒壁承受的環向拉力與內壓及半徑成正比，由水平預力鋼腱預先施加的壓力抵銷，使混凝土在設計壓力下仍不受拉開裂。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The containment is the last physical barrier between radioactive material and the environment and must withstand the internal pressure and temperature of steam released by a pipe break. Large pressurized-water units mostly use a prestressed concrete cylinder with a hemispherical or shallow dome and a steel liner for leak-tightness; hoop tension in the wall is proportional to internal pressure and radius and is offset by compression from horizontal tendons so the concrete does not crack in tension at design pressure. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：典型大型乾式圍阻體內半徑約 20 至 23 m，筒壁厚約 1 至 1.3 m
steps.observationEn: Project file: A typical large dry containment has an inside radius of about 20 to 23 m and a wall about 1 to 1.3 m thick
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「圍阻體的作用只是防止飛機撞擊。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The only purpose of a containment is to stop aircraft impact." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「圍阻體壓力與預力」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Containment pressure and prestress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 圍阻體壓力與預力
knowledge.text: 圍阻體是放射性物質與環境之間的最後一道實體屏障，必須承受管路斷裂事故時蒸汽釋放造成的內壓與溫度。大型壓水式機組多採預力混凝土圓筒加半球或淺穹頂，內襯鋼板確保氣密；圓筒壁承受的環向拉力與內壓及半徑成正比，由水平預力鋼腱預先施加的壓力抵銷，使混凝土在設計壓力下仍不受拉開裂。
knowledge.textEn: The containment is the last physical barrier between radioactive material and the environment and must withstand the internal pressure and temperature of steam released by a pipe break. Large pressurized-water units mostly use a prestressed concrete cylinder with a hemispherical or shallow dome and a steel liner for leak-tightness; hoop tension in the wall is proportional to internal pressure and radius and is offset by compression from horizontal tendons so the concrete does not crack in tension at design pressure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：圍阻體的作用只是防止飛機撞擊。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The only purpose of a containment is to stop aircraft impact. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 典型大型乾式圍阻體內半徑約 20 至 23 m，筒壁厚約 1 至 1.3 m
knowledge.textEn: A typical large dry containment has an inside radius of about 20 to 23 m and a wall about 1 to 1.3 m thick

quiz.question: 依「圍阻體壓力與預力」的模型 N_θ = p·r，設計壓力下圓筒壁每公尺高度的環向拉力（壓力與半徑為代表值）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model N_θ = p·r for "Containment pressure and prestress", which value is closest to the hoop force per metre of wall height at design pressure (representative pressure and radius)?
options: 9.9 MN/m
optionsEn: 9.9 MN/m
quiz.explanation: N_θ = p·r；代入 p = 0.45 MPa、r = 22 m，得 9.9 MN/m（設計壓力下圓筒壁每公尺高度的環向拉力（壓力與半徑為代表值））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: N_θ = p·r; with p = 0.45 MPa, r = 22 m the result is 9.9 MN/m (hoop force per metre of wall height at design pressure (representative pressure and radius)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 圍阻體壓力與預力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Containment pressure and prestress: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「圍阻體壓力與預力」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Containment pressure and prestress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：N_θ = p·r；代入 p = 0.45 MPa、r = 22 m，得 9.9 MN/m（設計壓力下圓筒壁每公尺高度的環向拉力（壓力與半徑為代表值））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 p 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: N_θ = p·r; with p = 0.45 MPa, r = 22 m the result is 9.9 MN/m (hoop force per metre of wall height at design pressure (representative pressure and radius)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise p by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：p 增加 10% 時，結果變為 10.9 MN/m（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising p by 10% changes the result to 10.9 MN/m (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 9.9 MN/m（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 p 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 9.9 MN/m (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in p with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: N_θ = p·r；代入 p = 0.45 MPa、r = 22 m，得 9.9 MN/m（設計壓力下圓筒壁每公尺高度的環向拉力（壓力與半徑為代表值））。
knowledge.textEn: N_θ = p·r; with p = 0.45 MPa, r = 22 m the result is 9.9 MN/m (hoop force per metre of wall height at design pressure (representative pressure and radius)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: p 增加 10% 時，結果變為 10.9 MN/m（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising p by 10% changes the result to 10.9 MN/m (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「圍阻體壓力與預力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Containment pressure and prestress"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
只要建築物不倒，裡面的設備就一定能正常運作。
完工時做結構完整性試驗（加壓到設計壓力的 1.15 倍並量測變形）與整體洩漏率試驗；運轉期間定期量測鋼腱預力、檢查錨頭與防蝕油脂。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If the building does not collapse, the equipment inside will certainly keep working.
At completion run a structural integrity test, pressurising to 1.15 times design pressure while measuring deformation, and an integrated leak-rate test.
quiz.explanation: 完工時做結構完整性試驗（加壓到設計壓力的 1.15 倍並量測變形）與整體洩漏率試驗；運轉期間定期量測鋼腱預力、檢查錨頭與防蝕油脂。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At completion run a structural integrity test, pressurising to 1.15 times design pressure while measuring deformation, and an integrated leak-rate test; in service measure tendon force and inspect anchor heads and corrosion-protection grease periodically. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 圍阻體壓力與預力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Containment pressure and prestress: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「圍阻體壓力與預力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Containment pressure and prestress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 完工時做結構完整性試驗（加壓到設計壓力的 1.15 倍並量測變形）與整體洩漏率試驗；運轉期間定期量測鋼腱預力、檢查錨頭與防蝕油脂。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At completion run a structural integrity test, pressurising to 1.15 times design pressure while measuring deformation, and an integrated leak-rate test; in service measure tendon force and inspect anchor heads and corrosion-protection grease periodically. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：鋼腱監測計畫要預先訂定預力預測帶與行動門檻，量測值低於預測下限時須擴大抽樣並做工程評估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The tendon surveillance programme should define a predicted force band and action levels in advance, and readings below the lower bound require expanded sampling and engineering evaluation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鋼腱因鬆弛、混凝土潛變與腐蝕而損失預力；若預力低於設計下限，事故壓力下混凝土將出現拉應力與裂縫，氣密只剩鋼內襯承擔。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Tendons lose force through relaxation, concrete creep and corrosion; below the design minimum, accident pressure puts the concrete in tension and cracks it, leaving leak-tightness to the liner alone. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 完工時做結構完整性試驗（加壓到設計壓力的 1.15 倍並量測變形）與整體洩漏率試驗；運轉期間定期量測鋼腱預力、檢查錨頭與防蝕油脂。
knowledge.textEn: At completion run a structural integrity test, pressurising to 1.15 times design pressure while measuring deformation, and an integrated leak-rate test; in service measure tendon force and inspect anchor heads and corrosion-protection grease periodically.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 鋼腱監測計畫要預先訂定預力預測帶與行動門檻，量測值低於預測下限時須擴大抽樣並做工程評估。
knowledge.textEn: The tendon surveillance programme should define a predicted force band and action levels in advance, and readings below the lower bound require expanded sampling and engineering evaluation.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IAEA SSR-5 放射性廢棄物處置。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IAEA SSR-5 Disposal of Radioactive Waste. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「圍阻體壓力與預力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Containment pressure and prestress" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 鋼腱因鬆弛、混凝土潛變與腐蝕而損失預力；若預力低於設計下限，事故壓力下混凝土將出現拉應力與裂縫，氣密只剩鋼內襯承擔。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
圍阻體是完全不漏氣的。
optionsEn: Tendons lose force through relaxation, concrete creep and corrosion.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
A containment does not leak at all.
quiz.explanation: 鋼腱因鬆弛、混凝土潛變與腐蝕而損失預力；若預力低於設計下限，事故壓力下混凝土將出現拉應力與裂縫，氣密只剩鋼內襯承擔。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Tendons lose force through relaxation, concrete creep and corrosion; below the design minimum, accident pressure puts the concrete in tension and cracks it, leaving leak-tightness to the liner alone. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 圍阻體壓力與預力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Containment pressure and prestress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「圍阻體壓力與預力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Containment pressure and prestress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鋼腱因鬆弛、混凝土潛變與腐蝕而損失預力；若預力低於設計下限，事故壓力下混凝土將出現拉應力與裂縫，氣密只剩鋼內襯承擔。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「預力混凝土圍阻體與整體洩漏率試驗」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Tendons lose force through relaxation, concrete creep and corrosion; below the design minimum, accident pressure puts the concrete in tension and cracks it, leaving leak-tightness to the liner alone. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Prestressed Concrete Containment and Integrated Leak-Rate Testing”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：大型壓水式機組多採預力混凝土圓筒加半球或淺穹頂，內襯鋼板確保氣密；圓筒壁承受的環向拉力與內壓及半徑成正比，由水平預力鋼腱預先施加的壓力抵銷，使混凝土在設計壓力下仍不受拉開裂。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Large pressurized-water units mostly use a prestressed concrete cylinder with a hemispherical or shallow dome and a steel liner for leak-tightness; hoop tension in the wall is proportional to internal pressure and radius and is offset by compression from horizontal tendons so the concrete does not crack in tension at design pressure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「圍阻體的作用只是防止飛機撞擊。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The only purpose of a containment is to stop aircraft impact." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 圍阻體內的空氣質量與容許洩漏量：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Air mass in a containment and the allowable leakage: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「圍阻體內的空氣質量與容許洩漏量」如何決定「預力混凝土圍阻體與整體洩漏率試驗」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Air mass in a containment and the allowable leakage” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Prestressed Concrete Containment and Integrated Leak-Rate Testing”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 圍阻體的氣密性以「每天漏掉多少比例的內部空氣」來規定。做整體洩漏率試驗時，把圍阻體用壓縮機加壓到事故的計算峰值壓力，關閉所有隔離閥，然後連續量測內部的壓力、溫度與濕度一天左右；由理想氣體定律算出每個時刻的乾空氣質量，其隨時間下降的斜率就是洩漏率。圍阻體裡的空氣有數百噸，而容許的洩漏只有千分之一，所以溫度量測的些微誤差就足以影響結果。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Leak-tightness of a containment is specified as the share of contained air lost per day. In the integrated leak-rate test compressors pressurise the containment to the calculated peak accident pressure, all isolation valves are closed, and pressure, temperature and humidity inside are measured for about a day; the ideal gas law gives dry-air mass at each moment, and its slope against time is the leak rate. The containment holds hundreds of tonnes of air and only a thousandth may leak, so slight errors in temperature measurement are enough to affect the result. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：設計壓力約 0.4 至 0.5 MPa，鋼內襯厚約 6 至 10 mm
steps.observationEn: Project file: Design pressure is about 0.4 to 0.5 MPa with a steel liner about 6 to 10 mm thick
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「圍阻體是完全不漏氣的。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A containment does not leak at all." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.

options: 416 kg/天
208 kg/天
optionsEn: 416 kg/day
4,162 kg/day
208 kg/day
quiz.explanation: ṁ = L·p·V / (R·T)；代入 La = 0.1 %/d、p = 500 kPa、V = 70000 m³、T = 293 K，得 416 kg/天（自由容積 70,000 m³、絕對壓力 500 kPa、溫度 293 K、容許洩漏率每天 0.1% 時的容許洩漏質量）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。

steps.title: 圍阻體內的空氣質量與容許洩漏量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Air mass in a containment and the allowable leakage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「圍阻體內的空氣質量與容許洩漏量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Air mass in a containment and the allowable leakage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ṁ = L·p·V / (R·T)；代入 La = 0.1 %/d、p = 500 kPa、V = 70000 m³、T = 293 K，得 416 kg/天（自由容積 70,000 m³、絕對壓力 500 kPa、溫度 293 K、容許洩漏率每天 0.1% 時的容許洩漏質量）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 La 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ṁ = L·p·V / (R·T); with La = 0.1 %/d, p = 500 kPa, V = 70000 m³, T = 293 K the result is 416 kg/day (allowable leakage mass for 70,000 m³ of free volume at 500 kPa absolute and 293 K with 0.1% a day allowed). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise La by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：La 增加 10% 時，結果變為 458 kg/天（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising La by 10% changes the result to 458 kg/day (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 416 kg/天（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 La 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 416 kg/day (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in La with an engineering explanation.
